raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Stop setting `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` in the ROCm, ROCK, and gfx1250 images.
- Legacy IPC export uses an ioctl that only the DKMS driver implements. On in-tree `amdgpu`, `hipIpcGetMemHandle` fails and RCCL P2P breaks.
- The UCX pin-leak workaround stays available as an explicit opt-in for Instinct hosts on DKMS. Fixes #61055.

## Test plan
- [x] On MI355X with the DKMS `amdgpu` driver, `hipIpcGetMemHandle` succeeds with the variable unset, `0`, and `1`.
- [ ] On an in-tree `amdgpu` host (Radeon / stock Ubuntu kernel), confirm the same call fails when the variable is `1` and succeeds when it is unset.
- [ ] Rebuild a ROCm image from this branch and confirm `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` is unset.
- [ ] On an Instinct + DKMS host that still hits the UCX `rocm_ipc` pin leak, confirm `-e HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` restores the previous workaround.

nodes.body:
The tests are incomplete. As the linked issue suggests, I introduced that flag after recommendation from our nixl team to resolve the test failures described in: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/38503

Please test thoroughly the related parts.
At the very least ci should keep this flag on btw. The linked issue does not apply to ci.

Restored `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` in the `ci_base` stage of `Dockerfile.rocm`, `Dockerfile.rock`, and `Dockerfile.rocm_gfx1250`. CI hosts use the DKMS driver, so #61055 does not apply there, and the NIXL/UCX `rocm_ipc` tests from #38503 keep the workaround.

The published runtime stages (`final` / `vllm-openai`) still leave the variable unset. On an MI355X with the DKMS `amdgpu` driver, `hipIpcGetMemHandle` succeeds with it unset, `0`, and `1`. Instinct hosts that still hit the UCX pin leak can opt in with `-e HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1`.

I have not re-run the NIXL disagg tests from #38503 on this branch. Those run from `ci_base`, which now has the flag again.

Re-ran the NixlConnector 2-GPU edge-case test that the AMD CI job runs (`tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/run_edge_case_test.sh`, `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`, TRITON attention) on an 8x MI355X DKMS host.

Image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (`v0.26.1rc1.dev668+g3ee2df303`). It already bakes `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1`, `UCX_RMA_PPLN_ENABLE=y`, and `UCX_ROCM_COPY_SIGPOOL_MAX_ELEMS=inf`. The two runs differ only by overriding `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` at `docker run`. Both runs instantiated the NIXL UCX backend.

| `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` | short prompt | full cache hit | partial cache hit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `1` (CI image) | pass | pass | fail |
| `0` (published runtime) | pass | pass | fail |

The partial-cache mismatch is identical in both runs (proxy vs prefill-only):

- proxy: ` and others. This is why we are able to work on projects that are open`
- prefill-only: ` and others. This is why we are able to work on projects like vLL`

Unsetting the flag does not change this test. The partial-hit failure also happens with the flag left on, so it is not a regression from dropping it in the published runtime image.

Limits of this run:

- The other six GPUs were in use, so the 4-GPU accuracy sweeps did not fit. This is the 2-GPU edge-case job.
- `--gpu-memory-utilization` was `0.08` instead of the script default `0.2`. vLLM's startup check wanted 57.6 GiB free for `0.2`, and the two usable GPUs did not have that much under that check.
- This host is DKMS, so it does not reproduce the in-tree amdgpu `hipIpcGetMemHandle` failure in #61055. That still needs a non-DKMS machine. DKMS is the setup the flag was added for.

Independently worked the same fix for #61055 and arrived at an identical diff — dropping our PR in favor of this one. Two things that may help it land:

**1. Supporting validation on the DKMS side.** On MI300X (gfx942, DKMS `amdgpu` 6.19.14 on kernel 6.8.0-134, ROCm 7.14), a minimal probe (`hipMalloc` 1 MiB + `hipIpcGetMemHandle`) succeeds with `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` set to `1`, `0`, and unset:

```text
--- HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1
malloc=hipSuccess ipc_export=hipSuccess
--- HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=0
malloc=hipSuccess ipc_export=hipSuccess
--- unset
malloc=hipSuccess ipc_export=hipSuccess
```

This matches your MI355X result, so removing the env from the runtime images doesn't regress DKMS/Instinct hosts. The failing side of the matrix (in-tree `amdgpu`, export fails with `hipErrorInvalidValue` when set to `1`) is already documented in the issue itself on gfx1201.

**2. Missing docs piece.** The issue asks for the workaround to be "documented as opt-in", which this PR doesn't cover yet. Here is the docs hunk we had prepared for `docs/features/nixl_connector_usage.md` (also available as commit e4fc9ad947 on [our branch](https://github.com/xxraincandyxx/vllm/commit/e4fc9ad947a032a4b39724ca1bdfd8c62c3caba8) — feel free to cherry-pick just that file):

```diff
--- a/docs/features/nixl_connector_usage.md
+++ b/docs/features/nixl_connector_usage.md
@@ -34,6 +34,12 @@ export UCX_NET_DEVICES=all  # or specify network devices like "mlx5_0:1,mlx5_1:1"
 !!! tip
     When using UCX as the transport backend, NCCL environment variables (like `NCCL_IB_HCA`, `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`) are not applicable to NixlConnector, so configure UCX-specific environment variables instead of NCCL variables.
 
+#### ROCm: optional `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` workaround
+
+On ROCm hosts running the DKMS `amdgpu` driver, setting `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` (e.g. `docker run -e HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1 ...`) works around a UCX `rocm_ipc` issue where GPU memory stays permanently pinned after buffers are freed ([rocm-libraries#6266](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/issues/6266)).
+
+Do not set it on hosts running the in-tree (stock kernel) `amdgpu` driver: the legacy IPC path relies on the `AMDKFD_IOC_IPC_EXPORT_HANDLE` ioctl, which only the DKMS driver implements. With it enabled there, every `hipIpcGetMemHandle` call fails, breaking RCCL P2P, vLLM's custom all-reduce, and CUDA-IPC tensor sharing ([vllm#61055](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61055)). The vLLM ROCm images therefore do not set it by default.
+
 #### Selecting a NIXL transport backend (plugin)
 
 NixlConnector can use different NIXL transport backends (plugins). By default, NixlConnector uses UCX as the transport backend.
```

(Investigation and validation done with AI assistance; probe code and logs available on request.)

Re-ran the AMD CI NixlConnector / NixlPushConnector scripts on a dedicated 8x MI355X (gfx950, DKMS) node, once with `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` and once with `=0`. Both settings passed every case below.

Image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (`v0.31.1rc1.dev296+gfe4df3df0`, digest `sha256:5983f95c6c89`). The image still bakes `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` and `UCX_RMA_PPLN_ENABLE=y`; each case overrides only the HSA flag. Attention backend is `TRITON_ATTN`. gsm8k exact-match thresholds are the ones in `test_accuracy.py` (Qwen3-0.6B 0.41, deepseek-vl2-tiny 0.19, rtol 0.05).

Host: Crusoe SPUR `amd-spur`, account `amd-agentx`, qos `amd-agentx-4-qos`, exclusive. Edge case ran on `crsuse2-m2m-188` (job 209145). The rest ran on `crsuse2-m2m-274` (job 209156, `COMPLETED 0:0`, 3h40m).

| Case | Script | HSA=1 | HSA=0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2-GPU edge, Qwen3-0.6B, util 0.2 | `nixl_integration/run_edge_case_test.sh` | pass | pass |
| 4-GPU accuracy sweep (Qwen TP 2/2, 1/2, 2/1 at util 0.6; deepseek-vl2-tiny TP 1/1, 1/2, 2/1 at util 0.8) | `config_sweep_accuracy_test.sh` | pass. Qwen 0.430 / 0.421 / 0.425; deepseek 0.202 / 0.196 / 0.199 | pass. Qwen 0.422 / 0.418 / 0.410; deepseek 0.201 / 0.202 / 0.196 |
| Same sweep with `CROSS_LAYERS_BLOCKS` | `config_sweep_accuracy_test.sh` | pass. Qwen 0.422 / 0.419 / 0.428; deepseek 0.198 / 0.202 / 0.199 | pass. Qwen 0.425 / 0.415 / 0.416; deepseek 0.196 / 0.199 / 0.196 |
| DP-EP, deepseek-vl2-tiny util 0.8 | `config_sweep_accuracy_test.sh` | pass. 0.203 / 0.202 | pass. 0.199 / 0.203 |
| Mamba prefix cache | `run_mamba_prefix_cache_test.sh` | pass | pass |
| MultiConnector accuracy | `run_multi_connector_accuracy_test.sh` | pass. 0.416 / 0.415 | pass. 0.418 / 0.412 |
| MultiConnector edge | `run_multi_connector_edge_case_test.sh` | pass | pass |
| NixlPushConnector accuracy (Qwen PP2/TP1 prefill, TP2 decode; then deepseek-vl2-tiny) | `nixl_push_integration/config_sweep_accuracy_test.sh` | pass. Qwen 0.413; deepseek 0.201 | pass. Qwen 0.417; deepseek 0.199 |

KV transfers in these logs reported `Num failed transfers=0`.

Not in this run: the hybrid-SSM sweep, the pytest list from #38503 itself, and a repeated start/stop measurement of the UCX `rocm_ipc` pin leak. This host uses the DKMS driver, so it also does not reproduce the in-tree amdgpu `hipIpcGetMemHandle` failure in #61055. The earlier shared-node edge run (util 0.08) is superseded by the table above.

An additional data point for the runtime-image change, from a setting the existing tests do not cover: an **unprivileged** container on a **DKMS** host.

**Environment:** 8x MI355X (gfx950), DKMS `amdgpu` 6.14.14, kernel 6.8, ROCm 7.2.3, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` nightly image. Kubernetes pod with default capabilities (no `SYS_PTRACE` / `SYS_ADMIN`), `NoNewPrivs=1`, seccomp RuntimeDefault, no `hostIPC`.

**Result:** with the image's `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1`, the export side succeeds, but the import side's `ioctl(AMDKFD_IOC_IPC_IMPORT_HANDLE)` returns `-1 EPERM` (strace). `hipIpcOpenMemHandle` then fails with `invalid device pointer`, so any TP >= 2 start fails in the custom all-reduce / RCCL init. Reversing parent and child (the parent imports the child's handle) fails the same way, so it is not a ptrace-ancestry restriction. The non-legacy (DMA-BUF) path works under the same restrictions.

Single-variable runs in one container. Only this variable changed; the other image ROCm variables stayed as shipped:

| `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` | 2-GPU `all_reduce` (torchrun) | torch CUDA tensor IPC | `vllm serve`, TP=4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1` (image default) | fails, `invalid device pointer` | fails | fails within ~70 s on all ranks |
| unset | passes | passes | ready in ~166 s, completions OK |
| `0` | passes | passes | ready, completions OK |

Unsetting other image variables one at a time (`ROCPROFILER_QUEUE_INTERPOSITION`, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM`, `HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG`) did not change the failure. Leaving only `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` reproduced it.

So in addition to the in-tree kernel case in #61055, the legacy setting also breaks multi-GPU serving in any unprivileged container on DKMS hosts. Keeping it only in `ci_base`, as this PR now does, fixes that for the published images. I have not checked whether a privileged or `hostIPC` container behaves differently.

@AndreasKaratzas @tjtanaa, could you take another look when you have a moment? Thank you.

Correction to my data point above: the `EPERM` on the import ioctl came from a restriction in our own node runtime, not from Kubernetes' default unprivileged pod settings. The platform owners have since lifted that restriction. So the table does not show a general problem with `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` in unprivileged containers; please don't weigh it as evidence for this PR. Sorry for the noise.

merged. Please rebase the PR, @ChuanLi1101.

Re-ran the AMD CI NixlConnector / NixlPushConnector scripts on a dedicated 8x MI355X (gfx950, DKMS) node, once with `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` and once with `=0`. Both settings passed every case below.

Image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (`v0.31.1rc1.dev296+gfe4df3df0`, digest `sha256:5983f95c6c89`). The image still bakes `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` and `UCX_RMA_PPLN_ENABLE=y`; each case overrides only the HSA flag. Attention backend is `TRITON_ATTN`. gsm8k exact-match thresholds are the ones in `test_accuracy.py` (Qwen3-0.6B 0.41, deepseek-vl2-tiny 0.19, rtol 0.05).

Host: Crusoe SPUR `amd-spur`, account `amd-agentx`, qos `amd-agentx-4-qos`, exclusive. Edge case ran on `crsuse2-m2m-188` (job 209145). The rest ran on `crsuse2-m2m-274` (job 209156, `COMPLETED 0:0`, 3h40m).

KV transfers in these logs reported `Num failed transfers=0`.

Not in this run: the hybrid-SSM sweep, the pytest list from #38503 itself, and a repeated start/stop measurement of the UCX `rocm_ipc` pin leak. This host uses the DKMS driver, so it also does not reproduce the in-tree amdgpu `hipIpcGetMemHandle` failure in #61055. The earlier shared-node edge run (util 0.08) is superseded by the table above.

An additional data point for the runtime-image change, from a setting the existing tests do not cover: an **unprivileged** container on a **DKMS** host.

**Environment:** 8x MI355X (gfx950), DKMS `amdgpu` 6.14.14, kernel 6.8, ROCm 7.2.3, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` nightly image. Kubernetes pod with default capabilities (no `SYS_PTRACE` / `SYS_ADMIN`), `NoNewPrivs=1`, seccomp RuntimeDefault, no `hostIPC`.

**Result:** with the image's `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1`, the export side succeeds, but the import side's `ioctl(AMDKFD_IOC_IPC_IMPORT_HANDLE)` returns `-1 EPERM` (strace). `hipIpcOpenMemHandle` then fails with `invalid device pointer`, so any TP >= 2 start fails in the custom all-reduce / RCCL init. Reversing parent and child (the parent imports the child's handle) fails the same way, so it is not a ptrace-ancestry restriction. The non-legacy (DMA-BUF) path works under the same restrictions.

Single-variable runs in one container. Only this variable changed; the other image ROCm variables stayed as shipped:

| `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY` | 2-GPU `all_reduce` (torchrun) | torch CUDA tensor IPC | `vllm serve`, TP=4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1` (image default) | fails, `invalid device pointer` | fails | fails within ~70 s on all ranks |
| unset | passes | passes | ready in ~166 s, completions OK |
| `0` | passes | passes | ready, completions OK |

Unsetting other image variables one at a time (`ROCPROFILER_QUEUE_INTERPOSITION`, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM`, `HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG`) did not change the failure. Leaving only `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` reproduced it.

So in addition to the in-tree kernel case in #61055, the legacy setting also breaks multi-GPU serving in any unprivileged container on DKMS hosts. Keeping it only in `ci_base`, as this PR now does, fixes that for the published images. I have not checked whether a privileged or `hostIPC` container behaves differently.

@AndreasKaratzas @tjtanaa, could you take another look when you have a moment? Thank you.

Correction to my data point above: the `EPERM` on the import ioctl came from a restriction in our own node runtime, not from Kubernetes' default unprivileged pod settings. The platform owners have since lifted that restriction. So the table does not show a general problem with `HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1` in unprivileged containers; please don't weigh it as evidence for this PR. Sorry for the noise.
